name: Inpost International
author: InPost

sections.description:
InPost International is the official free InPost app for international delivery services.

With this app, you can easily create shipments and pickup orders, track the status of your parcels, print labels, or request a pickup. Please read the documentation before using the plugin.

What are the benefits of installing the plugin?

  • Access to the InPost International service
  • Search for pickup points based on the latest Geowidget map
  • A constantly updated and always current list of pickup points
  • Generation of shipping labels and courier pickups
  • Management of shipments and pickup orders, as well as shipment tracking
  • Management of service availability in products

After installing the plugin, configure the InPost delivery method and prices for individual services so that your customers can choose their favorite delivery method.

Information on how to obtain access data for the service is included in the documentation. Full documentation and plugin installation instructions can be found at:
InPost International Documentation

If you have any questions, please use our contact form available at Support | InPost.
After entering the form, simply select Customer Support from the list, select InPost International Module in the category, and enter WooCommerce in the “Please enter the name of the module” field.

Ta wtyczka łączy się z interfejsem API, aby uzyskać kod uwierzytelniania: adres URL, w zależności od trybu „Sandbox” lub „Production”:
https://sandbox-login.inpost-group.com/
https://login.inpost-group.com/

Ta wtyczka łączy się z interfejsem API, aby tworzyć przesyłki i pobierać etykiety przesyłek: adres URL, w zależności od trybu „Sandbox” lub „Production”:
https://sandbox-api.inpost-group.com
https://api.inpost-group.com

Usługa ta jest świadczona przez „InPost sp. z o.o.”: warunki korzystania, regulamin, polityka prywatności znajdują się tutaj.

https://login.inpost-group.com/

This plugin connects to the API to create shipments and get shipment labels: url, depending on mode “Sandbox” or “Production”:
